_comment: Rules shared by the bot (build.rs turns them into Rust constants), the supervisor and the dashboard. Change them here only.

futures._comment: A continuous series futures:<code> trades its nearest contract and moves to the next one roll_days before the last trading day, at roll_time_utc (the start of the MOEX main session).

commissions._comment: Tariff defaults, % of a trade's volume (T-Invest, 2026). A rate measured from the commissions actually charged replaces them once a type has min_trades trades and min_volume_rub of volume over measure_days.
